Sam B: Heads-up — Mariner Labs capacity bring-up tomorrow 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a 2-hr load test window. Can folks confirm availability? @mariner-ops

Jess L: Available. CS lead will sit in. Quick note: renewal convo next week — we want clean perf metrics for the account health review.

Tony K: I'll own autoscale config. Proposing min=2 reserved nodes, max=10, scale step=2, cool-down=90s. Will post terraform diff to the thread.

Sam B: Thanks. @Tony K can you add warm pool +1 GPU for burst? Also need priming plan for KV cache + prefix cache.

Tony K: Yep — warm pool +1. For priming, suggest a focused 10k-token prefix warm using golden prompts (avoid full corpus warm to save cost). Maria, can you share the prompt set?

Maria P: Sharing priming script and a sample k6 snippet. Also recommend running model-variant fallback tests (quantized vs full-precision).

Maria P: ```bash
# k6 example
k6 run --vus 150 --duration 20m --out json=out.json load_test.js
```

Sam B: Load window locked 09:15–11:15 PT (shifted 15m to allow warmup). CS will capture feedback forms. @Jess L can you push the enablement checklist to Mariner and get attendee list?

Jess L: On it. I'll send a short pre-test checklist and capture team leads' NPS/concerns post-run. Also will note renewal talking points if perf has hiccups.

cs-bot: Capacity reservation confirmed: pool 'mariner-std' reserved 3 GPUs (reservation id rsv-8821).

Tony K: I'll run a dry run at 06:00 PT to validate autoscaler triggers — expect brief ~500 qps spikes to exercise scale-up. Will post logs.

Maria P: Reminder: include a simple fallback curl test for tool-calling and structured output paths, e.g. `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d @payload.json` to validate routing.

Sam B: Risk note: if warmup exceeds 30m we may push into customer's internal SLAs — keep priming lean and focused. Jess, please flag any exec-level concerns before 08:00.

Jess L: :thumbsup: will do. Any other blockers? If not, I'll run the enablement call 08:30 PT and share the join link.

Tony K: No blockers from infra.

Sam B: Great. I'll update the runbook (will paste link after edits) and post a results thread after the test. Thanks team :rocket:
